title: Frequency identification of Young modulus with a local 95% interval
source: The consistent two-element axial rod model has K=(EA/h)[[2,-1],[-1,1]] and M=(rho A h/6)[[4,1],[1,2]] after the fixed node is removed. The determinant gives 7 lambda^2 - 240000 lambda + 576000000 = 0 for E=1000 Pa, rho=1 kg/m^3, h=0.5 m; both frequencies scale as sqrt(E).

quantities.reason: The two observed frequencies are the closed-form rod frequencies multiplied by sqrt(1.21), so E=1210 Pa exactly.
Independent 0.01 Hz errors give sigma_E=0.746527736824412 Pa; the endpoint is E-1.959963984540054 sigma_E.
The same independent-error linearization gives E+1.959963984540054 sigma_E.
